description: Flat metadata schema for individual records from CLIP-seq studies of RNA-binding protein interactions during vertebrate embryonic development.

record_id.descr: Unique identifier for the metadata record or sample. Example: 'Xenopus_CLIP_001'.

study_id.descr: Identifier linking the record to the parent study or project.

organism_common_name.descr: Common name of the vertebrate organism. Example values: zebrafish, mouse, Xenopus, chick.

organism_scientific_name.descr: Scientific name of the organism. Example: 'Danio rerio'.

taxon_id.descr: NCBI Taxonomy identifier for the organism.

developmental_stage_name.descr: Name or label of the embryonic developmental stage. Example: 'shield stage', 'E8.5', 'HH10'.

developmental_stage_value.descr: Numeric representation of the developmental stage when available. Example: hours post fertilization, somite number, or gestational age.

anatomical_region.descr: Embryonic tissue, organ, or anatomical region sampled. Example: neural tube, somite, limb bud.

cell_type.descr: Cell type or cell population if applicable. Example: germ cells, neural progenitors.

sample_source.descr: Source of the biological material. Example values: whole embryo, dissected tissue, cultured embryonic cells.

rna_binding_protein_name.descr: Name of the RNA-binding protein investigated.

rna_binding_protein_symbol.descr: Standard gene or protein symbol for the RNA-binding protein.

rna_binding_protein_id.descr: Database identifier for the protein or gene. Example: UniProt accession, Ensembl gene ID, or NCBI Gene ID.

assay_type.descr: Experimental assay used to detect protein-RNA interactions. Example: CLIP-seq, iCLIP, eCLIP, HITS-CLIP, PAR-CLIP.

crosslinking_method.descr: Crosslinking chemistry or irradiation approach used prior to immunoprecipitation. Example values: UV 254 nm, UV 365 nm, formaldehyde.

immunoprecipitation_antibody.descr: Antibody used for immunoprecipitation, including target and clone if available.

library_preparation_method.descr: Library construction protocol used after crosslinking/immunoprecipitation. Example: small RNA library prep, eCLIP library kit.

sequencing_platform.descr: High-throughput sequencing platform used. Example: Illumina NovaSeq, HiSeq, NextSeq.

sequencing_read_length_bp.descr: Sequencing read length in base pairs.

replicate_number.descr: Biological or technical replicate number for the record.

replicate_type.descr: Type of replicate. Example values: biological, technical.

condition_name.descr: Experimental condition associated with the sample. Example: wild type, knockdown, mutant, treated.

control_type.descr: Control sample type used for comparison. Example: input, IgG control, size-matched input, no-antibody control.

interaction_detected.descr: Whether an RNA-protein interaction was detected for this record. True if binding evidence is present, false otherwise.

target_rna_name.descr: Name of the bound RNA transcript, RNA class, or transcript cluster.

target_rna_id.descr: Database identifier for the target RNA or transcript. Example: Ensembl transcript ID, RefSeq accession, miRBase ID.

target_gene_symbol.descr: Gene symbol associated with the target RNA when applicable.

binding_site_start.descr: Start coordinate of the mapped binding site on the transcript or genome, if available.

binding_site_end.descr: End coordinate of the mapped binding site on the transcript or genome, if available.

binding_site_coordinate_system.descr: Coordinate system used for binding_site_start and binding_site_end. Example values: transcript, genome, chromosome.

binding_site_score.descr: Quantitative score representing evidence strength for the interaction. Example: peak score, enrichment score, or confidence score.

p_value.descr: Statistical significance of the interaction call, if computed.

fdr.descr: False discovery rate associated with the interaction call, if computed.

coverage_reads.descr: Number of sequencing reads supporting the interaction or peak.

normalization_method.descr: Method used to normalize read counts or interaction scores. Example: CPM, TPM, RPM, size-factor normalization.

reference_genome_assembly.descr: Reference genome assembly used for alignment and mapping. Example: GRCz11, GRCm39.

alignment_tool.descr: Software used for read alignment. Example: STAR, Bowtie, BWA.

peak_calling_tool.descr: Software or algorithm used to call enriched binding sites or peaks.

protocol_notes.descr: Free-text notes on protocol deviations, special handling, or relevant experimental details.

publication_doi.descr: DOI of the associated publication, if available.

experiment_date.descr: Date when the experiment was performed, if known.
